source_image.origin: Original uploaded shelf photo associated with Output #7; copied from runtime storage for reproducible tests.

ground_truth_provenance.basis: User-provided product identities, planogram rows, and desired alert outcomes, cross-checked against the original photo and frozen Output #7 snapshot.
limits: This is scenario-level audit truth, not a pixel-accurate bounding-box annotation set.
Per-item counts in the description are operator estimates; use row identity and the stated acceptance policies as the stable assertions until boxes are manually annotated.
Do not use this fixture to claim detector precision/recall or calibrated physical-position accuracy.

observed_products.placement: interleaved among chocolates; approximately after ten chocolates when counted from the right

observations.policy: A low-stock alert is permitted only when observed/expected quantity is at most 0.50; 14/15 is above the threshold.

observed_products.count_status: full; approximately one or two facings may differ from planogram

observations.policy: Treat a full same-SKU row with a count delta of at most two as compliant for this initial fixture.

acceptance_scope: Scenario and policy regression only; object-box truth and physical measurements are not fully annotated.
